title: CP/MAS NMR studies on binding environment of CH3CN in Cu(I) complexes with disilane-bridged bis(methylpyridine) ligands
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,16968-16972
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02962G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Kei-ichi Sato, Mineyuki Hattori, Yoshinori Yamanoi
CP/MAS NMR confirmed the presence of CH3CN in Cu(I) complexes, and coordinated and non-coordinated CH3CN molecules in the crystalline state were successfully distinguished by natural abundance 15N CP/MAS NMR.
